provenance: Self-authored controls executed in the original virtual G1, with native typed STDDEV results and separate-process profile restoration.

cases.name: ordinary_1
cases.source: EXPORT ZZT_EXSTD() BEGIN LOCAL R,O:={};IFERR R:=stddev({1,2}); O:=CONCAT(O,{{TYPE(R),STRING(R)}}); THEN O:=CONCAT(O,{"error"}); END; IFERR R:=stddev({1,3}); O:=CONCAT(O,{{TYPE(R),STRING(R)}}); THEN O:=CONCAT(O,{"error"}); END; IFERR R:=stddev({1,1,1}); O:=CONCAT(O,{{TYPE(R),STRING(R)}}); THEN O:=CONCAT(O,{"error"}); END; IFERR R:=stddev({}); O:=CONCAT(O,{{TYPE(R),STRING(R)}}); THEN O:=CONCAT(O,{"error"}); END; RETURN O; END;

cases.name: structure_2
cases.source: EXPORT ZZT_EXSTD() BEGIN LOCAL R,O:={};LOCAL ONE:=1,HEXONE:=#1h,LVAL:={1,3},VVAL:=[1,3],WVAL:={1,3},WVEC:=[1,3];IFERR R:=stddev([1+0,2,3]); O:=CONCAT(O,{{TYPE(R),STRING(R)}}); THEN O:=CONCAT(O,{"error"}); END; IFERR R:=stddev({1+0,2,3}); O:=CONCAT(O,{{TYPE(R),STRING(R)}}); THEN O:=CONCAT(O,{"error"}); END; IFERR R:=stddev({ONE,2,3}); O:=CONCAT(O,{{TYPE(R),STRING(R)}}); THEN O:=CONCAT(O,{"error"}); END; IFERR R:=stddev([ONE,2,3]); O:=CONCAT(O,{{TYPE(R),STRING(R)}}); THEN O:=CONCAT(O,{"error"}); END; RETURN O; END;

cases.name: runtime_values
cases.source: EXPORT ZZT_EXSTD() BEGIN LOCAL R,O:={};LOCAL A1:={1,2,3}, V1:=[1,2,3], WV:=[1,3], VL:=[1,-3];IFERR R:=stddev(A1); O:=CONCAT(O,{{TYPE(R),STRING(R)}}); THEN O:=CONCAT(O,{"error"}); END; IFERR R:=stddev(V1); O:=CONCAT(O,{{TYPE(R),STRING(R)}}); THEN O:=CONCAT(O,{"error"}); END; IFERR R:=stddev(VL); O:=CONCAT(O,{{TYPE(R),STRING(R)}}); THEN O:=CONCAT(O,{"error"}); END; IFERR R:=stddev(VL,WV); O:=CONCAT(O,{{TYPE(R),STRING(R)}}); THEN O:=CONCAT(O,{"error"}); END; RETURN O; END;

cases.name: decimal_modes
cases.source: EXPORT ZZT_EXSTD() BEGIN LOCAL R,O:={};IFERR R:=stddev([1.0,2.0,3.0]); O:=CONCAT(O,{{TYPE(R),STRING(R)}}); THEN O:=CONCAT(O,{"error"}); END; IFERR R:=stddev([1.00,3.0],[1.0,3.0]); O:=CONCAT(O,{{TYPE(R),STRING(R)}}); THEN O:=CONCAT(O,{"error"}); END; IFERR R:=stddev({1.25,2,3}); O:=CONCAT(O,{{TYPE(R),STRING(R)}}); THEN O:=CONCAT(O,{"error"}); END; IFERR R:=stddev({1,3},{1,2.5}); O:=CONCAT(O,{{TYPE(R),STRING(R)}}); THEN O:=CONCAT(O,{"error"}); END; RETURN O; END;

cases.name: sqrt_limit
cases.source: EXPORT ZZT_EXSTD() BEGIN LOCAL R,O:={};IFERR R:=stddev({0,1000003,2000006}); O:=CONCAT(O,{{TYPE(R),STRING(R)}}); THEN O:=CONCAT(O,{"error"}); END; IFERR R:=stddev({0,10000000007,20000000014}); O:=CONCAT(O,{{TYPE(R),STRING(R)}}); THEN O:=CONCAT(O,{"error"}); END; IFERR R:=stddev({0,10000000,10000001}); O:=CONCAT(O,{{TYPE(R),STRING(R)}}); THEN O:=CONCAT(O,{"error"}); END; IFERR R:=stddev({0,100000001,100000003}); O:=CONCAT(O,{{TYPE(R),STRING(R)}}); THEN O:=CONCAT(O,{"error"}); END; RETURN O; END;

cases.name: weighted_exact
cases.source: EXPORT ZZT_EXSTD() BEGIN LOCAL R,O:={};IFERR R:=stddev({1,3},{100000,300000}); O:=CONCAT(O,{{TYPE(R),STRING(R)}}); THEN O:=CONCAT(O,{"error"}); END; IFERR R:=stddev({1,3},{1000000001,3000000003}); O:=CONCAT(O,{{TYPE(R),STRING(R)}}); THEN O:=CONCAT(O,{"error"}); END; IFERR R:=stddev({0,1,3},{0,1,0}); O:=CONCAT(O,{{TYPE(R),STRING(R)}}); THEN O:=CONCAT(O,{"error"}); END; IFERR R:=stddev({0,1,3},{1,-1,1}); O:=CONCAT(O,{{TYPE(R),STRING(R)}}); THEN O:=CONCAT(O,{"error"}); END; RETURN O; END;

cases.name: round_abs
cases.source: EXPORT ZZT_EXSTD() BEGIN LOCAL R,O:={};LOCAL T:=stddev({1,2,3});IFERR R:=ROUND(T); O:=CONCAT(O,{{TYPE(R),STRING(R)}}); THEN O:=CONCAT(O,{"error"}); END; IFERR R:=ROUND(T,-2); O:=CONCAT(O,{{TYPE(R),STRING(R)}}); THEN O:=CONCAT(O,{"error"}); END; IFERR R:=ABS(T); O:=CONCAT(O,{{TYPE(R),STRING(R)}}); THEN O:=CONCAT(O,{"error"}); END; IFERR R:=approx(ABS(T)); O:=CONCAT(O,{{TYPE(R),STRING(R)}}); THEN O:=CONCAT(O,{"error"}); END; RETURN O; END;

cases.name: save
cases.source: EXPORT ZZT_EXKEEP() BEGIN LOCAL R:=stddev({1,2,3}),F:=stddev({1,2}); L1:={R,F,ROUND(R,10),ABS(F)}; RETURN {TYPE(L1(1)),STRING(L1(1)),TYPE(L1(2)),STRING(L1(2)),TYPE(L1(3)),STRING(L1(3)),TYPE(L1(4)),STRING(L1(4))}; END;

cases.name: reopen
cases.source: EXPORT ZZT_EXREAD() BEGIN LOCAL P:=approx(L1); RETURN {TYPE(L1(1)),STRING(L1(1)),TYPE(L1(2)),STRING(L1(2)),TYPE(L1(3)),STRING(L1(3)),TYPE(L1(4)),STRING(L1(4)),TYPE(P),P}; END;
